title: Search touch-close focus correction
summary: Supplemental desktop touch testing found body focus after close. Corrected fallback and retained first-build evidence; corrected source needs revalidation.

changes.detail: Do not treat body/documentElement as a valid opening control; use the visible header search trigger when touch did not focus a control. Capture dialog roots for reliable cleanup and remove introduced ref-cleanup lint warnings.

validation.name: Initial candidate
validation.detail: Production build/types/lint exit 0 and 59 browser checks passed. Existing image lint warning; two cleanup-ref warnings addressed by this correction.

validation.name: Supplemental touch close
validation.detail: At 1440px touch emulation, closing could leave focus on body. Candidate withheld; correction requires build and focused revalidation.

validation.name: Harness limitation
validation.detail: Earlier result-link navigation timeout preserved: local catalogue is deliberately disconnected. Keyboard activation/href and close behavior tested separately; input shortcut routing uses a browser-only destination probe.
